title: 14th Sitting of Third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/14/3/2026).

From the Speaker's desk: the no-confidence motion against Minister of Economic Development, Transport and Trade Mohamed Saeed, submitted under Article 101(h) of the Constitution and Article 229(h) of the Parliament's Rules of Procedure.

Preliminary debate on a resolution to find out MPs' views on the government's decision to take fourteen plots of land away from Malé City Council's control and declare them State property, submitted by South Galolhu MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: This sitting was set to take up a no-confidence motion against the economic development minister and debate a resolution on the government taking fourteen Malé City Council plots.
